notes:
• In the desktop app, More… in the new-pane menu (Ctrl+Cmd+N or the ▾) opens native ZTC and shell panes and delegated Codex and ZTC workers.
• Delegated ZTC workers run read-only on a locked Zerg Router profile and ask you in the app for more; delegated Codex runs read-only too.
• Saved layouts bring native panes back inactive, and resuming one checks it is the exact same session, so old work never restarts itself.
changes: The new-pane menu's More… opens native panes and delegated workers.
Native panes run on a lease of their worktree, and delegated workers on a task file.
Status lists native panes and delegated workers, and the title bar names the delegated Router.
Saved layouts bring native panes back inactive.
Delegated ZTC runs read-only on a locked Zerg Router profile and asks you first.
npm run acceptance:daily-driver checks the desktop's native panes.
Library hosts can supply tool checkpoints, compaction, guarded remote resources, hooks and MCP servers.
The zerg-ztc/tools export gives a library the CLI's default tool list
A headless run can ask a remote service for approvals and answers
Domain tools declare their effects and capabilities
A run set up by environment alone can name an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
